post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: A four-file length probe targeted final seed paths before they existed; PowerShell surfaced missing-path diagnostics while the pipeline returned a misleading zero status.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact final seed paths were confirmed absent before additive creation, and no pre-existing owner file was overwritten.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Treat every diagnostic as authoritative, confirm the seeds are absent with exact paths, and add them only through reviewed patches.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Do not infer success from a pipeline status when an upstream PowerShell command emitted an error record.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: A read-only x1 shape probe assumed a lifecycle-plan filename that was never frozen and returned a missing-path error.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact committed x1 workflow and route records were located and reread without mutation.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Use the committed workflow-plan and route-plan filenames discovered by an exact bounded listing.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Enumerate the exact owner directory before borrowing a lifecycle filename from a sibling pattern.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: A combined three-window reference read of Lyren's large final builder exceeded the attributable output boundary and was truncated.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The Ilyra final builder, validator, staged review, and tests are owner-specific, bounded, and independently linted and compiled.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Use only bounded exact sections needed for lifecycle shape and author an owner-specific implementation with independently tested contracts.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Read one bounded reference window per invocation and stop once the required interface is established.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: The first bounded closeout lint rejected one repeated prefix predicate in the builder and four unnecessary generator-to-set constructions in the validator.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: All four unchanged per-file Ruff scopes and all four Python compilations passed after the five local structural rewrites.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Replace only the five deterministic local structures, then rerun the unchanged four-file Ruff and compilation scopes.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Run per-file lint immediately after authoring each closeout component and before generating dependent artifacts.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: A combined manifest, strict-JSON, and privacy scan outlived its initial yield, while the orchestration summary omitted the returned session identifier and left no attributable terminal result.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The Git batch manifest pass replayed 23 final-delta and 173 owner entries with exact coverage, while the separate owner pass strict-parsed 170 JSON blobs and found zero confirmed hits across 176 text blobs.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Inspect process quiescence, retain the unattributable attempt, and split the unchanged read-only scope into an exact manifest pass and a separate owner JSON/privacy pass.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Always preserve a long-running session identifier or split Git-blob loops before their initial yield budget.
